LATEST PLAYER EXACT IN-CHARACTER: "That is precisely what I mean. I have already earned a number of new holdings and even a marriage to another influential house. Whether we restore my old holdings is a bonus to whatever I've done so far." Response to Edric Vale's prompt at Day289~13:30 Nightglass records room: does V envision House SEVERIN retain its identity, existing lands/property and duties, self-government and lawful privileges beneath renewed House VAISHNAVI political banner? YES, explicitly. V says House Vaishnavi's standing is already grounded in his modern personal achievements: established Blackthorn Hold title, separate Miregate River estates, and alliance/claimed marriage with influential RETHWYN, not solely speculative recovery of lost Vaishnavi ancestral seat/lands. Latest player description as 'marriage' is V's in-character description of the Rethwyn association; owning documents as of DAY233 establish V+Lady Elara Rethwyn mutually signed PRIVATE eight-clause "Compact of Houses Rethwyn and Vaishnavi", with independent witnesses Mara Venn and Fenar Raukhar, original physically guarded in Cirren Seventh's carried document case. Formal registered wedding/royal marriage/Crown recognition after Day233 is NOT established in owning QUESTS, NPCS or private correspondence, so do not invent a ceremony, create spousal rights, transfer House property, or overrule current law from the word 'marriage' alone; Edric diplomatically acknowledges the compact's binding private commitments and influential alliance, while noting public/Crown recognition remains a separate matter. This preserves the user's V-character intent, not an unplayed historic wedding.

Edric long-serving steward and trusted VALE of Nightglass Hall independently responds with interest and recognition that V is NOT threatening to seize the property of House SEVERIN, absorb their title or reduce Lord Severin to a household servant, or demand loyalty before establishing his own claim. He reasons that restored allied/seigneurial relationship might be plausible if they independently agree: House SEVERIN retains its current name and lawful title, property and household administration, while voluntarily recognizing senior restored Vaishnavi political association and receiving reciprocal mutual protection and cooperation, with duties/financial obligations to be negotiated by the HOUSE HEADS, not sworn/codified by Edric. A senior house relationship here is a PROPOSAL, not present legal fealty, a titled lordship the crown acknowledges, or automatically superior foreign sovereignty. Edric observes modern tangible V lands in Crownsunder and Rethwyn private compact make V's position more serious but do not by themselves prove an ancient title or legal jurisdiction over Nightglass. Mara independently favors mutual dignity/modern lives not ancient claims alone. Edric voluntarily AGREES to bring the clarified proposal to Lord Severin for consideration; no instant formal response or authorization because Lord Severin still absent. His concrete willingness to advocate is accepted NEW NPC knowledge/intent, not a signed agreement. The original previous Day289~13:30 inspected Heart RECOVERY/PACKING ACCOUNT and carrier mark tracing remain at records table; last documented service-house district only, Orsaven field book held at separate collection; no new location revealed, documents copied, reward declared or V resource spent. Clock Day289~13:35, actual party at NIGHTGLASS HALL RECORDS ROOM with Edric, Mara, Cirren and Fenar; four owned horses/coach in courtyard with water. V no new items or spells. V 48/48 HP AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 free Whispers1/1; equipped attuned Cloak of Protection and attuned Stone of Good Luck 2/3 slots, magic +1 all V ability checks/saves/initiative, NOT AC/attacks. Fenar59/59HP HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 MP6/6 CLIMB40; Cirren51/51 full spell slots/CD2; Mara healthy. Purse329gp1sp6cp, rations21 ration-person-days/feed28 animal-days, sealed Pixie Dust1, weighted LongRest5/6. V retains actual Kestrel original regional authorization/EVERMARCH CLEAR WILL/transfer ledger/false discharge folios/signed clinical trial papers/ordinary mage pouch; Mara her Neri notes, Fenar six sealed reagents/tool, none revealed to Edric or Lord Severin. Sedgecross eleven liberated patients still under prepaid care and direct earlier Blackthorn offer; no unplayed estate payout or news. NEXT pending V action remains at records table: continue examining source/tracing, request Orsaven copies by ordinary channels, or address further details with Edric/Lord Severin if/when he arrives. No V assumed legal signature or commitments to levy military forces, protection payments, oath, or forced vassalage.
